passed_but_unrecorded_gate.why_unrecorded: The driver called _execute_timed successfully enough to retain complete checker streams and GNU time output, but _command_record rejected the returned result before appending it to report.commands.

failed_gate.name: driver-command-record
failed_gate.exception: ValueError: command failed or lacks exact GNU time metrics: test-campaign-stage-creation
combined_rejection_predicate: missing or invalid exact GNU time metrics

independent_diagnosis.mechanism: After communicate returned, _execute_timed permanently set termination_uncertain as soon as the process group was observed alive once. The checker uses multiprocessing spawn, Event and Queue, so a short-lived Python resource_tracker or other same-group descendant can outlive the successful leader. The implementation retained the uncertain flag even when subsequent cleanup left no live group.
independent_diagnosis.proof_limit: The v3 report discarded the pre-rejection _execute_timed result, so it did not retain returncode, timed_out, termination_uncertain, derived signal, or before/after process-group state. The exact failing subpredicate therefore cannot be machine-proved from v3 artifacts alone.

mathematical_regression_reason: No original or Rust Atlas process ran and no mathematical result was produced; the failure is in harness process-group observation after a checker completed successfully.

remediation_contract.natural_exit_grace: After a successful leader exit only, allow a short bounded no-signal grace for same-group descendants to disappear naturally.
remediation_contract.timeout_policy: Do not add the grace to timeout handling.
remediation_contract.persistent_group_policy: If the group remains after the grace, preserve termination_uncertain=true, run the existing TERM-to-KILL cleanup, and reject the command even when cleanup succeeds.
remediation_contract.final_group_check: Retain the final process-group liveness check and outer-finally cleanup.
remediation_contract.diagnostics: Persist the failed command result and exact failed_checks so later reports distinguish exit status, timeout, termination uncertainty, signal and GNU time parse or consistency failure.

transport.initial_transfer: The first scp ended with a partial remote payload: independent verification found missing or zero-length content and group-writable directory modes. No creator invocation occurred from that payload.
